questions.q: What is the duration of the DevOps training program?
questions.a: The DevOps training program lasts for 12 weeks and includes hands-on labs, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment exercises.

questions.q: Do you offer weekend classes for the Data Science bootcamp?
questions.a: Yes, the Data Science bootcamp is available in both weekday and weekend schedules depending on the cohort timing.

questions.q: How do I reset my learner account password?
questions.a: To reset your learner account password, click the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and follow the email reset instructions.

questions.q: Is the AWS Cloud Practitioner course beginner-friendly?
questions.a: Yes, the AWS Cloud Practitioner course is designed for beginners and focuses on basic cloud concepts before moving to more advanced services.

questions.q: What certificate do students receive after completing the AI Engineer program?
questions.a: Students receive a UTrains completion certificate and can also earn recognized platform badges for project work and assessments.

questions.q: Can I access course recordings after finishing a cohort?
questions.a: Yes, learners typically retain access to recorded lessons and lab material for a limited time after the program ends, depending on the enrollment plan.

questions.q: What support do I get during the Python for Automation track?
questions.a: Students receive instructor feedback, office hours, technical troubleshooting help, and project review support throughout the training track.

questions.q: Does UTrains provide internship placement support?
questions.a: UTrains offers career guidance, portfolio reviews, and job readiness support, while placement outcomes depend on each learner's background and performance.

questions.q: What is the refund policy for paid training programs?
questions.a: The refund policy is determined by the enrollment terms, but most programs allow a cooling-off period before the course starts.
